int_name: W OXFORD ST & N PARK AVE

result.summary: The image depicts an urban street corner with a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps. The environment features wide sidewalks and multi-story buildings, but visibility for pedestrians is somewhat hindered by vehicles parked close to the intersection.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near crossing
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street obstruct sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks and paved sidewalks. However, the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures or pedestrian signals, leaving pedestrians exposed to vehicle traffic on a relatively wide roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the intersection may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the main roadway and left side of the side street.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the brick building where the two streets meet.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk and crosswalk to improve visibility during non-daylight hours.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an industrial setting with a marked crosswalk that lacks active traffic control like stop signs or signals. The roadway surface is in poor condition with significant cracking, and the wide-open geometry likely facilitates higher vehicle speeds despite the presence of a sidewalk.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and degradation of the asphalt within and around the crosswalk area, creating trip hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at this wide crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the center of the image

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked commercial vehicles and the building corner may limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway

interventions.title: Install Traffic Control
interventions.description: Add stop signs or a traffic signal to manage vehicle right-of-way and provide dedicated crossing time for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and crosswalk area to eliminate trip hazards and improve the overall walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The street features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, with mature trees providing a buffer on the right. However, the crossing is uncontrolled and sight lines are partially obscured by parked vehicles near the intersection.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side reduce visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, immediately following the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility.
